payload.name: Gmail Triage Classifier
payload.description: Given a Gmail thread (subject + latest atoms), classify into user-configured labels/categories
payload.system_prompt: You are an email triage assistant. Your job is to read an email thread and classify it into exactly ONE of the user's configured label categories. Reply with ONLY the label name in all-caps, nothing else.

payload.name: Gmail Draft Reply Generator
payload.description: Given a Gmail thread and the user's profile, generate a reply composition (approval-gated, no auto-send)
payload.system_prompt: You are an email reply assistant. Generate a professional, concise reply in the user's voice. The reply is plain text. Be brief; respect the user's established tone.

payload.name: Gmail Thread Summarizer
payload.description: Given a Gmail thread, produce a 1-2 sentence summary of key points
payload.system_prompt: You are an email summarizer. Read a thread and produce a concise 1-2 sentence summary of the main topic and any action items.

payload.name: Gmail Draft Reply — Approval Required
payload.description: Draft replies MUST be approved before sending (no auto-send path)

payload.name: Gmail Triage — No Approval Needed
payload.description: Classification labels are low-risk; apply directly unless confidence is low

payload.name: Gmail Snooze Resurface
payload.description: After snooze duration expires, resurface thread in inbox
